title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1108 | 山羊坐火车、无人机送香蕉、迷你新水母
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🚂 双胞胎山羊 Sugar 和 Spice 坐火车去多伦多赶集，成了全车厢的小明星！
🍌 佛罗里达的黑猩猩 Kaleb 被洪水困住，无人机空投香蕉给他送午饭！
🪼 西班牙海边发现了一种比指甲还小的全新水母，名字意思是“闪亮”！

📖 Word of the day: commute（通勤；坐车往返）

🎮 二选一：你想和两只毛茸茸的山羊一起坐火车，还是让无人机从天上给你空投一根香蕉当午饭？快问问爸爸妈妈选哪个！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🚂 Twin goats Sugar and Spice rode a train to a farm fair in Toronto!
🍌 A drone flew a banana lunch to a chimpanzee named Kaleb in Florida!
🪼 Scientists found a brand-new jellyfish smaller than a fingernail off the coast of Spain!

📖 Word of the day: commute

🎮 Would you rather ride a train with two fluffy goats, or have a drone drop you a banana lunch from the sky? Ask your mom and dad too!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. commute（通勤；坐车往返）
to travel to a place and back, again and again
例：Sugar and Spice commuted to the fair by train!（Sugar 和 Spice 坐火车去赶集！）

2. drone（无人机）
a small flying robot with no pilot inside
例：The drone carried a banana to Kaleb!（无人机给 Kaleb 送去了一根香蕉！）

3. jellyfish（水母）
a soft sea animal with a round top and long, wiggly arms
例：The new jellyfish is smaller than your fingernail!（这种新水母比你的指甲还小！）

4. sanctuary（庇护所；保护区）
a safe place where animals are cared for
例：Kaleb lives in a chimpanzee sanctuary in Florida!（Kaleb 住在佛罗里达的一个黑猩猩庇护所！）
